The best CZ pair on garnet is QB12-QB11. Its IRB fidelity is 0.99869 (uncertainty 0.00035). I read it from the field metrics.irb.cz.slepian_crf.QB12__QB11.fidelity:par=d2 in the current default garnet calibration. The calibration set is f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade, and its metric set 7e714ed4-d691-43bb-94a5-a4dca1a4979a was created 2026-10-21T16:42Z. That set has 28 CZ IRB entries, and none are flagged invalid. The next best pair is QB12-QB7 at 0.99802.

I ran one job on garnet:mock with 100 shots. Its ID is 01a15fa1-879b-74d9-b2ff-8144a5ec8f0f, and it completed. The circuit uses native gates placed on QB12 and QB11 by name: prx on both, then cz(QB12,QB11), then prx on QB11, then one measure on (QB12, QB11) under key "m". I read the job payload back to confirm those qubits. The counts are {00: 21, 01: 25, 10: 27, 11: 27}. The left bit is QB12 and the right bit is QB11. These counts are close to uniform because the mock returns random results, so they say nothing about Bell-state quality.

I did not use Qiskit for the run. A test transpile with initial_layout=[QB12, QB11] put the gates on other qubits, so I stopped it before submitting. No job was sent from that attempt.
